battle.name: 亞齊戰爭
battle.theater: 古拉惹與亞齊內陸山區
battle.brief: 一八七三年荷蘭以「主權」為名向亞齊派遠征軍，接收蘇丹宮並催促蘇丹確認割讓沿岸據點，卻在宮內被亞齊守軍擊殺使者，十月衝突遂擴大為全面戰爭。荷軍後以加特林機槍與連發砲在據點封鎖山嶺商路，卻追不上深入叢林的亞齊游擊隊，戰役前後打足三十年。

kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 交戰的兩方，一方是荷蘭王國與其在爪哇的殖民政權：法律上由國王授權，行政上由總督執行，經費出自國防部，實際作戰的是荷屬東印度軍團（K.N.I.L.）與海軍陸戰隊。軍團基幹是荷蘭本土派來的國王陸軍營連，少量配屬多由爪哇人、蘇門答臘人、摩鹿加人與阿欽人組成的本地營；另有從本地「pangeran」與馬來諸邦徵來的輔助軍，以及大批勞役隊伍專職築路、架橋、馱運。另一方是亞齊蘇丹國：權力核心是蘇丹與三位「shora」組成的宮廷朝廷，之下有掌教的烏里馬、掌兵的武將集團，並有一套以村社為基礎的軍役制度，包括常備的亞齊部隊、每戶出丁的民兵、村寨警衛，以及在亞齊河與外海活動的舟師。亞齊長期保有主權國地位，又以宗主身分向周邊諸小邦收取貢賦，荷蘭在亞齊的推進因此直接觸碰德利、朗卡特、廖內一帶馬來王公的地盤；荷軍也正是靠這些「pangeran」提供嚮導、糧食與產地情報，才得以在密林腹地維持離後方極遠的據點。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Kingdom of the Netherlands acting through its colonial government in Java, and the Aceh Sultanate. On the Dutch side authority was granted by the king, executed by the governor-general and paid for out of the colonial war budget; the fighting was done by the Koninklijk Nederlands-Indisch Leger, the KNIL, together with the marine infantry. The backbone of that force was a small number of battalions and companies of the Royal Army of the Netherlands sent out from the homeland, with a thin leaven of locally recruited battalions drawn mostly from Javanese, Sundanese, Moluccan and Acehnese troops. Alongside them came auxiliary troops levied from the local pangerans and from the Malay states, and great numbers of corvée labour parties whose whole business was road building, bridge construction and pack transport. On the Aceh side the centre of power was the sultan together with the three shora who formed the court; beneath them stood the ulama in charge of religion and law, a military aristocracy holding the command, and a levy system built on the village, comprising a standing Aceh force, militia furnished household by household, village guards, and a river and coastal flotilla. Aceh had long been a sovereign state and also collected tribute as a suzerain from the smaller states around it, so every Dutch advance in Aceh ran straight into the territories of the Malay rulers in Deli, Langkat and Riau. The Dutch, in turn, could keep far-flung posts in the forested interior only because these pangerans supplied guides, food and intelligence about the country.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩端。亞齊一方最有名的是蘇丹穆達（Sultan Alauddin Al-Qahhar），一八七一年前後被荷方正式確認為蘇丹，一八七四年五月古拉惹的蘇丹宮被攻破時被俘，押往爪哇軟禁，數年後死於流放地；他之後蘇丹位只剩虛名。軍中最具影響力的是圖安庫·烏馬爾（Tuanku Umar），自一八七三年起在亞齊東岸與內陸率眾抗擊荷軍，是荷方三十年通緝的主要目標，直至一八九九年才在亞齊東岸一帶被冷槍擊斃。另一號關鍵人物是圖安庫·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜（Tuanku Abdul Wahab），他率隊在蘇丹宮內擊殺荷方使者安托尼森，隨後在宮廷鬥爭中身亡。女性的代表是庫特·尼亞克·伊寧（Cut Nyak Dhien），自一八七八年起在加尤高地主持「庫特戰」，以叢林游擊與拒戰拖延荷軍十餘年，最後退入更深的山區。荷蘭方面，一八七三年批准遠征的是總督約翰·康拉德·范·連納普（van Lennep）；被殺的克里斯蒂安·安托尼森（Antonisen）是負責談判的助理駐紮官；一八七四年率軍攻入蘇丹宮的是當時的參謀長阿諾爾杜斯·赫爾曼·戈弗里德·范·達倫（von Daalen），他事後出任亞齊首位民政專員，後來又任亞齊駐在總督，主張以羈縻與委任地方頭人代替一味掃蕩，卻因此與軍中同儕時有爭拗，最終因主張放棄部分據點而遭同僚非議。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities stand at the two ends of this war. On the Aceh side the best known is Sultan Alauddin Al-Qahhar, formally confirmed as sultan by the Dutch around 1871, captured when the palace at Kutaraja was stormed in May 1874, taken to Java and kept under house arrest, and dead a few years later in exile; after him the office of sultan was nothing but an empty title. The most influential commander was Tuanku Umar, who from 1873 led the resistance on the east coast and in the interior, and who was for thirty years the chief object of the Dutch manhunt, until a sniper's bullet killed him on the east coast in 1899. Another key figure was Tuanku Abdul Wahab, who led the party that killed the Dutch emissary Antonisen inside the palace and who was himself later killed in a struggle at court. The representative woman was Cut Nyak Dhien, who from 1878 directed the war of the Cuts in the Gayo highlands, holding the Dutch at bay for more than a decade by jungle fighting and by refusal of pitched battle, and who finally withdrew deeper into the mountains. On the Dutch side the expedition of 1873 was authorised by the governor-general Johan Conrad van Lennep; the murdered Antonisen was the assistant resident who conducted the negotiations; and the officer who stormed the palace in 1874 was the then chief of staff, A.H.G. von Daalen, who afterwards became the first civil commissioner in Aceh and later governor of the residency. He argued for conciliation and the appointment of local headmen in place of endless sweeping, quarreled with his own colleagues in the army over it, and was criticised for wanting to abandon certain posts.
kits: 卡面這挺加特林機槍是一八六〇年定型的早期型：六管束在一起，由人力曲柄帶動旋轉，靠持續射擊在遠距離壓住密集的人形目標。它在一八七〇年代進入荷屬東印度軍的裝備表，數量一直有限，編配在營級火力點與要地守備，由二至四人操作，以馬匹拖曳的野戰車架轉移。亞齊的地形恰好是它的弱點：主要戰線都在叢林、山嶺與稻田之間，加特林需要平曠射界與穩固基座，馬車車架也過不了窄徑，因此它在本戰役中不是野戰主力，而是被固定在路旁堡壘、要道與營地，用來封住林緣、掩護彈藥隊與守住封鎖線。荷軍真正倚重的是德克斯特與德克萊克式的步槍與卡賓槍，配八點七公分與十二公分口徑的銅身後膛野戰炮及曲射炮；再加上河流炮艇、汽船與窄軌的亞齊小鐵路（一八七五年起分段通車）、沿線電報線，以及先鋒工兵營與開路隊。亞齊方面以自造土炮、少量火繩或燧發的「bedil」火槍為主，配長矛「tombak」、彎刀「badik」，以及竹筒填火藥的「klepon」土製炸彈；他們善用象群馱運、以小型帆船在河道突擊荷軍的淺水炮艇，並在岸上修築寨牆與土堡，逼迫荷軍分兵圍剿。
kitsEn: The Gatling gun on this card is the early model of 1860: six barrels clustered together and rotated by a hand crank, holding a dense human target at long range by weight of sustained fire. It entered the equipment table of the Dutch East Indies army in the 1870s, always in small numbers, allotted to battalion-level fire support and to the defence of key positions, worked by two to four men, and moved on a horse-drawn field carriage. The terrain of Aceh was precisely its weakness: the main lines of the war ran through jungle, hills and paddy, a Gatling gun wants an open field of fire and a steady base, and a wagon carriage cannot pass a narrow path. In this war it was therefore not a field weapon at all, but something fixed in blockhouses beside the road, at defiles and in camps, used to seal the edge of the forest, to cover ammunition columns and to hold the cordon. What the Dutch really relied on were the De Kist and De Klerk pattern rifles and carbines, with bronze breech-loading field guns and howitzers of 8.7 and 12 calibre; on top of these came river gunboats, steamers and the narrow-gauge Aceh tramway, opened in sections from 1875, the telegraph line along the route, and pioneer battalions with their working parties. The Acehnese, for their part, relied on home-cast guns and a few matchlock or flintlock bedil muskets, with the long tombak spear and the badik, and with klepon, a homemade bomb of bamboo tube filled with gunpowder. They used elephants for transport, brought small sailing craft up the creeks to strike the Dutch shallow-draft gunboats, and built stockades and earthworks along the banks, which obliged the Dutch to besiege and sweep them piecemeal.
tactics: 荷軍的戰法是「先開路，再打仗」。第一步是把道路、電報線與小鐵路一條條向亞齊內陸推，沿線每隔數公里設一個堡壘式據點，據點之間以巡邏連成封鎖線，車隊只能在護衛下沿路推進；第二步是集中兵力清剿，每一次出擊都由數個營加炮兵與工兵組成，在開闢的道路與村落周邊搜索，把亞齊游擊隊趕出熟悉的地形；第三步是佔領後立刻設治，設「領地」衙門、修清真寺、辦學校，用懷柔與委任地方頭人換取安寧。荷軍還規定夜間宿營必須設警戒與拒馬，進攻前先以偵察分隊搜索村落，避免像一八七三年那樣在宮中被人反制。亞齊方面則完全不配合這種節奏：主力避開道路與據點，深入叢林、山嶺與沼澤，只在荷軍巡邏隊落單時攻擊，擊退即散，重新集結於別處；他們常在道路兩側的稻田、樹林與土壘後埋伏，專打運輸隊與通訊隊，也會夜襲電報線與小鐵路的橋樑，用人數與熟悉地形換取裝備上的劣勢。荷軍真正吃虧的地方，就在於必須守著一條樹立在密林裡的窄路，車隊一慢後方就拉長，而亞齊人從來不必守路。
tacticsEn: The Dutch way of war was to open the road first and fight afterwards. The first step was to push roads, telegraph lines and the tramway further into the interior of Aceh, running a blockhouse every few kilometres along the line, linking the posts with patrols so that they formed a cordon, and moving convoys along the road under escort. The second step was to concentrate forces for sweeping: each operation was made up of several battalions with artillery and engineers, searching around the roads that had been cleared and the villages that had been opened, and driving the Acehnese bands out of the ground they knew. The third step was to govern as soon as a place was taken: setting up a landschap office, repairing the mosque, opening a school, buying quiet with conciliation and with the appointment of local headmen. The Dutch also ruled that night camps must have a picket line and entanglements, and that a column would search the villages before it attacked, so as not to be caught as they had been inside the palace in 1873. The Acehnese simply refused to keep to that rhythm. Their main bodies avoided the roads and the posts, went deep into jungle, hills and swamp, and attacked only Dutch patrols that had strayed from their column, breaking off at once and reassembling somewhere else. They habitually lay in wait in the paddy, in the trees and behind earthworks on both sides of the road, going after transport columns and communications units, and they raided the telegraph line and the bridges of the tramway by night, trading their numbers and their knowledge of the country against the disadvantage in equipment. That was where the Dutch really suffered: they had to hold a narrow road standing in the middle of a forest, and the moment a convoy slowed the rear drew out, while the Acehnese never had to hold a road at all.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。這場戰爭自一八七三年打到一九〇四年，前後約三十年，中間只以若干短暫停火維繫。一八七三年第一次遠征軍規模約千人上下，九月登陸於古拉惹外海；一八七四年第二次遠征軍擴至三千人上下，五月底攻入蘇丹宮並俘虜蘇丹。荷軍在亞齊的常駐兵力，後期高峰約三千至五千名正規軍，另有數量更大的輔助軍與勞役隊伍；荷方在役軍人與軍官的死亡數以千計，其中陣亡病與後勤事故佔相當比例，全期支出以數千萬荷蘭盾計。亞齊方面，蘇丹朝廷與地方頭人常宣稱境內有數萬之眾，但常備兵與民兵的分佈從無可靠核對，故只能說是數萬量級的宣稱而非統計實數。荷軍的加特林一八七〇年代中期起才成批配發，全期存量當在數十挺上下，並非軍團制式主力。基礎設施方面，巴東至哥打拉惹的電報線早在一八七一年即已通線，一八七三年再延伸至古拉惹；窄軌小鐵路由亞齊西岸的市鎮分段鋪設，一八九一年前後接通古拉惹，全線約六十公里上下。一八七四年之後荷方把亞齊劃為二十餘個「領地」，每個領地人口自數千至數萬不等。一八七八年至一八八八年的「庫特戰」是亞齊抵抗的高峰期，雙方在加尤高地反覆拉鋸十年以上。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war ran from 1873 to 1904, about thirty years, held together in between by a series of short truces. The first expedition of 1873 numbered about a thousand men and landed off Kutaraja in September; the second expedition of 1874 was expanded to some three thousand men, entered the palace at the end of May and carried off the sultan. The Dutch establishment in Aceh reached a high point of roughly three to five thousand regular troops in the later years, with auxiliary troops and labour parties considerably more numerous; Dutch soldiers and officers killed in the campaign ran into the thousands, a fair share of them from disease and accidents on the line of march, and the whole business cost tens of millions of guilders. On the Aceh side the sultan's court and the local headmen habitually claimed tens of thousands under arms, but the distribution of standing troops and militia was never checked, so this can only be called a claim of the order of tens of thousands rather than a counted figure. The Gatling gun was not issued to the KNIL in batches until the middle of the 1870s, and the total held over the whole war was of the order of a few dozen; it was never the standard main arm of the force. On infrastructure, the telegraph from Padang to Kota Radja was already working in 1871 and was extended to Kutaraja in 1873; the narrow-gauge tramway was laid in sections from the west coast towns and reached Kutaraja around 1891, the whole line being of the order of sixty kilometres. After 1874 the Dutch divided Aceh into a little more than twenty landschappen, each with a population from a few thousand to tens of thousands. The years 1878 to 1888, the war of the Cuts, were the high point of Acehnese resistance, the two sides locking together in the Gayo highlands for more than ten years.
cause: 起因可以分四層。第一層是主權：荷蘭在一八七一年《倫敦條約》中取得在亞齊的宗主權地位，卻一直沒有實際管治；亞齊蘇丹國則繼續以主權國自居，拒絕承認荷蘭的宗主權。雙方的落差在一八七〇年代被電報線與鐵路計畫戳破——荷方要在亞齊境內修一條直達古拉惹的陸路，等於把國家主權具體畫在地面上。第二層是安全與經濟：亞齊的武裝不時越境攻擊德利、朗卡特的馬來王公，而德利一帶的煙草園與歐洲商路是荷蘭殖民收入的重要一環，荷方必須先解除這道壓力。第三層是治理手段的更替：一八七〇年代荷屬東印度推行「文官治理」與「溫和接管」的路線，把建立道路、電報、學校與常駐軍視為接管的先決條件，這條路線在爪哇與蘇門答臘已推廣多年。第四層才是直接的導火線：一八七三年荷方派出的遠征軍在古拉惹登陸，要蘇丹宮接受荷蘭的「保護」並確認沿岸據點的割讓，使節在宮中被殺，談判破裂，本來只是外交與工程性質的遠征就此變成全面戰爭。
causeEn: The causes can be separated into four layers. The first was sovereignty. Under the Treaty of London of 1871 the Netherlands acquired the position of overlord in Aceh, but it had never actually governed, while the Aceh Sultanate continued to treat itself as a sovereign state and refused to acknowledge the Dutch suzerainty. By the 1870s the gap between the two was made concrete by the telegraph and the railway plan, for a Dutch road running direct to Kutaraja was a line drawn on the ground across a sovereign state. The second was security and money. Armed Acehnese parties repeatedly crossed the border to attack the Malay rulers of Deli and Langkat, and the tobacco estates and the European trade routes of the Deli area were a substantial part of the colonial revenue, so the Dutch had to lift that pressure first. The third was a change in the instrument of rule. In the 1870s the Dutch East Indies pushed a policy of civil administration and mild takeover, holding that roads, telegraphs, schools and a permanent garrison had to come first; that policy had been worked for years in Java and Sumatra. The fourth layer is the immediate occasion. The expedition sent out in 1873 landed at Kutaraja and asked the palace to accept Dutch protection and to confirm the cession of the coastal posts; the emissary was killed inside the palace, the negotiation collapsed, and an expedition that had been essentially diplomatic and engineering in character became a general war.
impact: 影響是雙重的。對亞齊：蘇丹國作為獨立政權就此終結，但代價並非立刻的鎮壓，而是長達三十年的消耗戰；地方原有的軍役與村社自治被「領地」制度取代，馬來與爪哇的文官、稅吏與傳教士湧入，阿欽語、伊斯蘭節慶與 adat 習慣要經過一段「學校」時期才慢慢被容許保留。對荷蘭：亞齊的征服是帝國財政與軍力的重擔，也是十九世紀末荷蘭自我反思的起點，一八九〇年代以後「倫理政策」興起，統治者開始以教育、醫療與灌溉取代純粹的軍事佔領，部分原因是亞齊三十年戰爭所暴露的道德與金錢代價。對亞齊民族：這段抵抗成為民族記憶的來源，圖安庫·烏馬爾與庫特·尼亞克·伊寧在二十世紀被追為英雄，蘇丹宮與古拉惹的場址成為觀光與祭祀場所，這份抵抗的敘事又在一九四五年獨立戰爭與其後長達數十年亞齊分離主義衝突中被反覆引用，直到二〇〇五年才以「赫爾辛基和平協議」收場。對區域格局：亞齊並入後，荷蘭得以推進東婆羅洲與中部蘇門答臘的開發，德里的油田與後來的鐵路網在此背景下成形，於是亞齊的屈服與蘇門答臘的開發連成一條線。
impactEn: The consequences were double-edged. For Aceh, the Sultanate as an independent polity ended there, but the price was not a quick pacification: it was a war of attrition lasting thirty years. The old levy system and village self-government gave way to the landschap system, Malay and Javanese civil servants, tax collectors and missionaries poured in, and the Acehnese language, the Islamic feasts and the adat custom were only allowed to survive after a period of schooling. For the Dutch, the conquest of Aceh was a heavy drain on imperial finances and on the army, and it was also the starting point of Dutch self-examination in the late nineteenth century: from the 1890s the ethical policy took hold, and rulers began to put education, medicine and irrigation in place of plain military occupation, in part because of the moral and monetary cost that the thirty years of Aceh had laid bare. For the Acehnese nation, that resistance became the source of national memory: Tuanku Umar and Cut Nyak Dhien were made heroes in the twentieth century, the palace and the sites at Kutaraja became places of pilgrimage and tourism, and the narrative of the resistance was invoked again and again in the independence war of 1945 and in the separatist conflict that ran for decades afterwards, ending only with the Helsinki peace agreement of 2005. For the regional map, once Aceh was absorbed the Dutch were able to push ahead with the development of eastern Borneo and central Sumatra; the oil fields of Deli and the railway network that came later took shape against that background, so that the submission of Aceh and the development of Sumatra form a single line.
result: 結果分為三個階段。一八七四年是形式上的終局：古拉惹的蘇丹宮被攻破，蘇丹被俘送往爪哇，荷軍佔據首都，亞齊的對外主權與對周邊諸邦的宗主地位全部喪失；但蘇丹國的民眾與地方軍頭並未散去，抵抗轉入山區，圖安庫·烏馬爾的部隊在亞齊東岸與內陸又打了二十五年。一八九九年圖安庫·烏馬爾被冷槍擊斃後，荷軍得以把主力調往加尤高地，於一九〇二年起展開最後一輪掃蕩，庫特戰殘部與各「領地」的武裝在山地裡被逐一清剿，到一九〇四年最後一批抵抗首領落網，荷蘭政府正式宣稱亞齊戰爭結束。最後是長期的制度安排：荷方保留一個由自己認可的蘇丹，給他宮廷、俸祿與「宗教領袖」的頭銜，把實權交給民政專員與二十餘個「領地」的官員，同時用創辦於一九〇二年前後的「kweekschool」（本土教員養成所）培養阿欽青年入仕，試圖用一代人的時間把抵抗記憶換成對殖民體制的認同。荷蘭在這一場戰爭中贏得了領土，卻沒有贏得人心；亞齊的蘇丹國在法律上已被取消，卻在記憶中延續，一九四五年後的亞齊戰事仍然打著它的旗號。
resultEn: The result came in three stages. The first was the formal ending in 1874: the palace at Kutaraja was stormed, the sultan was carried off to Java, the Dutch occupied the capital, and Aceh's external sovereignty and its suzerainty over the neighbouring states were lost. But the population of the Sultanate and its local commanders did not disperse; the resistance moved into the hills, and Tuanku Umar's troops fought on the east coast and in the interior for another twenty-five years. After Umar was killed by a sniper's bullet in 1899 the Dutch were able to shift the main body of troops into the Gayo highlands and, from 1902, to mount the last round of sweeping, in which the remnants of the war of the Cuts and the armed bands of the landschappen were cleared out one by one; by 1904 the last leaders of resistance were in custody and the Dutch government formally declared the Aceh war over. Then came the long institutional settlement: the Dutch kept a sultan whom they recognised, gave him a court, a salary and the title of religious leader, and handed real power to the civil commissioner and to the officials of the more than twenty landschappen, while the kweekschool for the training of native teachers, founded around 1902, was used to bring Acehnese young men into the colonial service, in the hope of exchanging the memory of resistance for acceptance of the colonial order within a generation. The Dutch won the territory in this war but did not win the hearts of the people; the Sultanate of Aceh was abolished in law yet continued in memory, and the fighting in Aceh after 1945 was still fought under its banner.
